Messenger

You carried words that changed lives and learned when not to ask what they meant.

Which message did you refuse to deliver?

Rules

Type: Background. Status: Proposal. Choose one paired option; do not mix the rank from one with the card from another.

- Marksmanship 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.c7e449ebaee6bfc1.JournalEntryPage.b782e866f92f9dc8]{Pinning Shot}. - Influence 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b02ee871184ccbb6.JournalEntryPage.6f896fcaf7855c66]{Measured Appeal}.

Grant at level 0. Duplicate grants provide 1 stage DP each; never promote a rank automatically. No discipline purchases at level 0. Ancestry does not restrict this choice. Follow each card’s explicit equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +7 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
